activateNode.description: Transition a node to the active (blue) state.
activateNode.code: var nd=svg.select('#fc-node-'+args.id); if(nd.empty()) return; var c=registry.config.colors.active; nd.attr('data-state','active'); nd.select('.fc-shape').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.fill).attr('stroke',c.stroke).style('filter','url(#fc-glow)'); nd.selectAll('.fc-label').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.text);

markDone.description: Transition a node to the done (green) state.
markDone.code: var nd=svg.select('#fc-node-'+args.id); if(nd.empty()) return; var c=registry.config.colors.done; nd.attr('data-state','done'); nd.select('.fc-shape').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.fill).attr('stroke',c.stroke).style('filter','none'); nd.selectAll('.fc-label').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.text);

highlightNode.description: Transition a node to the highlight (yellow) state.
highlightNode.code: var nd=svg.select('#fc-node-'+args.id); if(nd.empty()) return; var c=registry.config.colors.highlight; nd.attr('data-state','highlight'); nd.select('.fc-shape').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.fill).attr('stroke',c.stroke).style('filter','url(#fc-glow)'); nd.selectAll('.fc-label').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.text);

dullNode.description: Transition a node to the dull (dim) state.
dullNode.code: var nd=svg.select('#fc-node-'+args.id); if(nd.empty()) return; var c=registry.config.colors.dull; nd.attr('data-state','dull'); nd.select('.fc-shape').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.fill).attr('stroke',c.stroke).style('filter','none'); nd.selectAll('.fc-label').transition().duration(350).attr('fill',c.text);

activateEdge.description: Animate a traveling dash along the edge from→to and highlight it.

resetEdge.description: Return an edge to its default style.

pulseNode.description: Brief stroke-width pulse to draw momentary attention to a node.

addAnnotation.description: Show a callout bubble beside a node with explanatory text.
